description: Source code for managing groups of parameters in a data model, including initialization, destruction, adding parameters, checking group ownership, and setting parameter values either individually or in groups via vendor hooks.

methods.name: GROUP_SET_VECTOR_Init
methods.description: Initializes a group set vector structure by setting its vector pointer to NULL and entry count to zero.

methods.name: GROUP_SET_VECTOR_Destroy
methods.description: Frees all memory associated with a group set vector, including paths and error messages.

methods.name: GROUP_SET_VECTOR_Add
methods.description: Adds a parameter to the group set vector after checking its existence, type, permissions, and ownership, and records errors if any.

methods.name: GROUP_SET_VECTOR_AreAllPathsTheSameGroupId
methods.description: Checks if all parameters in a specified slice of the vector share the same group ID.

methods.name: GROUP_SET_VECTOR_GetFailureIndex
methods.description: Finds the first required parameter in a slice that failed to set.

methods.name: GROUP_SET_VECTOR_SetValues
methods.description: Sets values for a slice of parameters, either individually or grouped by owner, handling errors and partial failures.
